caption: Kar. 30. Altar
reading: wosi? : so(2)rey?i : pkdi(3)qowi : kdimñl?e? te(4)dḫelowi : artwte : q?oe?d?i (5)tit : yetmdelowi : be?(6)loloke : (7)mnpt (8)ye?tmde(9)lowi : ḫr(10)pñ : pẖrsete(11)l? : yetmdelowi : p?ed?e?l?(12)m?ot?br : semlowi : (13)ḫmlole : (14)ẖol : wosi
notes: Many signs hatched. Line 2: the blob after e in soreyi drawn solid, read y?. Line 2-3 name: first two long-tailed signs p or k. Line 4 opens a ~ t (hatched) te; the ~ sign unclear (r?). Line 5 end 'yetmdelowi' fairly clear. Line 7: two hook signs sharing long tails, read n n uncertain. Line 11: a run of slashes and hatching between te? and o, read y? [.] [.] y?. The 'sic' sign before -elowi is an odd hooked sign, read b? only as a guess. Line 12: hatched start, a? = S plus hatched long-tailed sign; the two hatched slash+hook signs read te? te?. Line 13-14 opening sign looks like a c with a tail (ḫ?). The last group 'wosi' stands alone at the left end of the last row. Kar 30 uses '/ϟ with bar' = te and the end group '4B/ϟ' = lowi throughout.
check_notes: Names (A pkdiqowi, B kdimñl(?)e(?)), the woman's descriptions (Index A/B: artwte : qoeditit : yetmdelowi; beloloke : mnpt : yetmdelowi; ḫrp(e)ñ pẖrsetel : yetmdelowi; ped(?)e(?)l(?) : motbr : semlowi) and formula C (ḫmlole : ẖol) all placed. The copy's 'S' in beloloke and its '4' in ḫmlole are l in the type. The '////' hatching after the i of pkdi is hatching, not y. In line 11 the hatched strokes between te and y are read as l and a divider (type: pẖrsetel : yetmdelowi). The (e) of ḫrp(e)ñ is Griffith's restoration, not on the copy. Index C dates wosi to line 13; the copy puts the closing wosi after the line-14 group.

Line 3-4: first sign '/ plus K-shaped hook' read te?, next sign hatched (s?). Line 4: 'ꝛ' after k read d? (could be n or ñ). Line 5: a 3-shaped sign with a long tail (p? or ẖ) then a long run of thin slashes = lost stretch; about 12 sign widths, count estimated. Line 7-8: four 3-shaped signs and a small hook; m/s/ẖ not separable by shape (the bold one read s).

The copy has one more sign than the type in temeykdiye (a hatched 3 after te), kept. The copy shows one sign (3 with a long tail) at the start of the lost father's name, which the type leaves empty.

Title 'yi' is the first two signs of the name. In 'soni mnitowi' the copy shows a hatched sign and four dots where the type has three signs (m n i); kept as the copy. Formula C: the type has pẖo and four dots; the copy has three hatched signs after o, kept.

caption: Kar. 35. Stela
notes: Line 1 has no divider between wosi and soreyi. Line 2: '/7' and '/3' before 'S B 4' read q (could be m+o or s+o); 'S' between q and w read e (pattern looks like -qowi/-lowi but the copy shows S). '52' at the start of line 2's left half read a (could be k+e). 'ᴗ//' with hatching read se?. Last group: 3 with a dotted line under it, two H-like 4 signs, S, /3, / ; read s? i? i? e q o; text ends there.
check_notes: All three names placed: (qo)mdeyeqewi, weredikeyeqewi, k(?)dilqo. The copy's '52' I read as a at the start of the second name is w + e (the w here has a tail). The (qo) is in Griffith's round brackets; the copy shows two signs there, kept with '?'.
